item.title: Frozen Florida Iguanas Are Falling From Trees, Here’s What To Do!
item.description: A cold snap in Florida can turn an ordinary sidewalk into a surprise hazard. When air temperatures fall into the 40s and 30s, green iguanas can become cold stunned and drop from trees. They may look dead, but their bodies are still working and they can spring back to life once things warm up.
